items.title: HYROX confirms the 26/27 UK calendar
items.summary: London, Glasgow, Cardiff and Birmingham all land on the new season calendar, with the usual sell-out warnings attached. Full dates and venues are on the official site.
items.take: Book the hotel before you book the heat — Saturday waves go first and nobody enjoys a 6 a.m. start in a city an hour away. Birmingham taught me that one.

items.title: Doubles fields keep getting quicker
items.summary: Pro doubles times across the season are trending down, with more sub-hour pairs turning up at every major race.
items.take: Elite 15 isn't a flex, it's a warning — the pairs game is where this sport is heading. Find your partner before you need one; the race-mate board exists for a reason.

items.title: The station nobody trains enough
items.summary: Ask a room of first-timers which station worries them and it's always the sled. Ask the people who've raced and they say wall balls — the station that looks easy and empties your legs.
items.take: Performance isn't about having perfect conditions. It's about finding a way to execute anyway.
